fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/release/... ./tools/release/... builds a manifest from a dist folder with the four archives and checksums.txt and checks every field and that the sha256s match checksums.txt; the release-snapshot job writes the manifest and fails unless all four platforms are in it
fields.statement: Every v* release publishes manifest.json beside its archives: channel (release), version, commit, and for each os/arch the archive URL and sha256, so releases/latest/download/manifest.json always names the newest release

fields.acceptance: release.yml runs actions/attest-build-provenance over dist/*.tar.gz with id-token: write and attestations: write; goreleaser check and the release-snapshot job pass on the PR; after v0.1.0 is cut by hand, gh attestation verify passes on one of its archives (recorded as Evidence)
fields.statement: The release job publishes a GitHub build-provenance attestation for every archive, so gh attestation verify <archive> --repo dphaener/rhiza succeeds on a downloaded release
